CREATE     OR ALTER  VIEW silver.master_src_rpt as
SELECT 
    COALESCE(r.[report_name], s.[report_name])             AS [report_name],
   -- COALESCE(r.[accounting_period], s.[accounting_period])
    '09/30/2026' AS [accounting_period],
    COALESCE(r.[lob], s.[lob])                             AS [lob],
    COALESCE(r.[jurisdiction], s.[jurisdiction])           AS [jurisdiction],
 
    COALESCE(s.[total_claims], 0)                          AS [src_total_claims],
    COALESCE(r.[total_claims], 0)                          AS [rpt_total_claims],
    COALESCE(s.[total_net_liab_amt], 0.00)                 AS [src_net_liab_amt],
    COALESCE(r.[total_net_liab_amt], 0.00)                 AS [rpt_net_liab_amt],
    
    COALESCE(s.[total_approved_payment_amt], 0.00)         AS [src_approved_amt],
    COALESCE(r.[total_approved_payment_amt], 0.00)         AS [rpt_approved_amt],
    COALESCE(s.[total_access_fee], 0.00)                   AS [src_access_fee],
    COALESCE(r.[total_access_fee], 0.00)                   AS [rpt_access_fee],
    COALESCE(s.[total_claim_liab_amt], 0.00)               AS [src_claim_liab_amt],
    COALESCE(r.[total_claim_liab_amt], 0.00)               AS [rpt_claim_liab_amt],
    COALESCE(s.[total_admin_amt], 0.00)                    AS [src_admin_amt],
    COALESCE(r.[total_admin_amt], 0.00)                    AS [rpt_admin_amt]
FROM [silver].[master_rpt] r
INNER JOIN [silver].[master_src] s
    ON r.report_name=s.report_name
	AND r.[accounting_period] = s.[accounting_period]
   AND r.[lob]               = s.[lob]
   AND r.[jurisdiction]      = s.[jurisdiction]

CREATE OR ALTER     VIEW silver.misc_src_bucketAB_detail AS

WITH BucketA AS (
    -- Universe of all claims active or reported during the period
    SELECT 
        report_name,
        [claim_id],
        [policy_no],
        [lob],
        [jurisdiction],
        [accounting_period],
        [approved_payment_amt],
        [access_fee],
        [claim_liab_amt],
        [admin_amt],
        [net_liab_amt]
    FROM [bronze].[opening_claims_src]
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        report_name,
        [claim_id],
        [policy_no],
        [lob],
        [jurisdiction],
        [accounting_period],
        [approved_payment_amt],
        [access_fee],
        [claim_liab_amt],
        [admin_amt],
        [net_liab_amt]
    FROM [bronze].[new_added_claims_src]
),
ClosedSet AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT [claim_id] FROM [bronze].[closed_claims_src]
),
PurgedSet AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT [claim_id] FROM [bronze].[deleted_purged_claims_src]
),
GLEndingSet AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT [claim_id] FROM [bronze].[gl_reported_ending_src]
)

SELECT a.* from 

 BucketA a
LEFT JOIN ClosedSet   c ON a.[claim_id] = c.[claim_id]
LEFT JOIN PurgedSet   p ON a.[claim_id] = p.[claim_id]
LEFT JOIN GLEndingSet g ON a.[claim_id] = g.[claim_id]

-- Filters only for claims present in Bucket A but missing from Bucket B
WHERE c.[claim_id] IS NULL 
  AND p.[claim_id] IS NULL 
  AND g.[claim_id] IS NULL

    SELECT 
        [claim_id],
        [policy_no],
        [lob],
        [jurisdiction],
        [accounting_period],
        [approved_payment_amt],
        [access_fee],
        [claim_liab_amt],
        [admin_amt],
        [net_liab_amt]
    FROM [bronze].[deleted_purged_claims_src]
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        [claim_id],
        [policy_no],
        [lob],
        [jurisdiction],
        [accounting_period],
        [approved_payment_amt],
        [access_fee],
        [claim_liab_amt],
        [admin_amt],
        [net_liab_amt]
    FROM [bronze].[gl_reported_ending_src]

OpeningSet AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT [claim_id] FROM [bronze].[opening_claims_src]

NewAddedSet AS (

SELECT 
b.*

CREATE OR ALTER     VIEW [silver].[misc_bucketAB_src_rpt] AS
WITH Aggregated_BucketAB_src AS (
    -- Aggregate the report-side details (Bucket A)
    SELECT 
        [accounting_period],
        [lob],
        [jurisdiction],
        COUNT(DISTINCT [claim_id])    AS [rpt_total_claims],
        SUM([net_liab_amt])           AS [rpt_net_liab_amt],
        SUM([approved_payment_amt])   AS [rpt_approved_amt],
        SUM([access_fee])             AS [rpt_access_fee],
        SUM([claim_liab_amt])         AS [rpt_claim_liab_amt],
        SUM([admin_amt])              AS [rpt_admin_amt]
    FROM [silver].[misc_src_bucketAB_detail]
    GROUP BY 
        [accounting_period],
        [lob],
        [jurisdiction]
),
Aggregated_BucketAB_rpt AS (
    -- Aggregate the source-side details (Bucket B)
    SELECT 
        [accounting_period],
        [lob],
        [jurisdiction],
        COUNT(DISTINCT [claim_id])    AS [src_total_claims],
        SUM([net_liab_amt])           AS [src_net_liab_amt],
        SUM([approved_payment_amt])   AS [src_approved_amt],
        SUM([access_fee])             AS [src_access_fee],
        SUM([claim_liab_amt])         AS [src_claim_liab_amt],
        SUM([admin_amt])              AS [src_admin_amt]
    FROM [silver].[misc_rpt_bucketAB_detail]
    GROUP BY 
        [accounting_period],
        [lob],
        [jurisdiction]
)

SELECT 
    -- 1. Dimensions (Consolidated via COALESCE from both Buckets)
    'misc_bucketAB'                                         AS [report_name],
    COALESCE(a.[accounting_period], b.[accounting_period]) AS [accounting_period],
    COALESCE(a.[lob], b.[lob])                             AS [lob],
    COALESCE(a.[jurisdiction], b.[jurisdiction])           AS [jurisdiction],

    -- 2. Claim Counts (Source vs Report)
    COALESCE(b.[src_total_claims], 0)                      AS [src_total_claims],
    COALESCE(a.[rpt_total_claims], 0)                      AS [rpt_total_claims],

    -- 3. Net Liability (Total Reserve Balance)
    COALESCE(b.[src_net_liab_amt], 0.00)                   AS [src_net_liab_amt],
    COALESCE(a.[rpt_net_liab_amt], 0.00)                   AS [rpt_net_liab_amt],

    -- 4. Component Breakdown Amounts
    COALESCE(b.[src_approved_amt], 0.00)                   AS [src_approved_amt],
    COALESCE(a.[rpt_approved_amt], 0.00)                   AS [rpt_approved_amt],

    COALESCE(b.[src_access_fee], 0.00)                     AS [src_access_fee],
    COALESCE(a.[rpt_access_fee], 0.00)                     AS [rpt_access_fee],

    COALESCE(b.[src_claim_liab_amt], 0.00)                 AS [src_claim_liab_amt],
    COALESCE(a.[rpt_claim_liab_amt], 0.00)                 AS [rpt_claim_liab_amt],

    COALESCE(b.[src_admin_amt], 0.00)                      AS [src_admin_amt],
    COALESCE(a.[rpt_admin_amt], 0.00)                      AS [rpt_admin_amt]

FROM Aggregated_BucketAB_src a
FULL OUTER JOIN Aggregated_BucketAB_rpt  b
    ON  a.[accounting_period] = b.[accounting_period]
    AND a.[lob]               = b.[lob]
    AND a.[jurisdiction]      = b.[jurisdiction];

CREATE OR ALTER   VIEW [silver].[misc_bucketBA_src_rpt] AS
WITH Aggregated_BucketBA_src AS (
    -- SOURCE metrics aggregated here from Bucket B details
    SELECT 
        [accounting_period],
        [lob],
        [jurisdiction],
        COUNT(DISTINCT [claim_id])    AS [src_total_claims],
        SUM([net_liab_amt])           AS [src_net_liab_amt],
        SUM([approved_payment_amt])   AS [src_approved_amt],
        SUM([access_fee])             AS [src_access_fee],
        SUM([claim_liab_amt])         AS [src_claim_liab_amt],
        SUM([admin_amt])              AS [src_admin_amt]
    FROM [silver].[misc_src_bucketBA_detail]
    GROUP BY 
        [accounting_period],
        [lob],
        [jurisdiction]
),
Aggregated_BucketBA_rpt AS (
    -- REPORT metrics aggregated here from Bucket B details
    SELECT 
        [accounting_period],
        [lob],
        [jurisdiction],
        COUNT(DISTINCT [claim_id])    AS [rpt_total_claims],
        SUM([net_liab_amt])           AS [rpt_net_liab_amt],
        SUM([approved_payment_amt])   AS [rpt_approved_amt],
        SUM([access_fee])             AS [rpt_access_fee],
        SUM([claim_liab_amt])         AS [rpt_claim_liab_amt],
        SUM([admin_amt])              AS [rpt_admin_amt]
    FROM [silver].[misc_rpt_bucketBA_detail]
    GROUP BY 
        [accounting_period],
        [lob],
        [jurisdiction]
)

SELECT 
    -- 1. Dimensions (Consolidated via COALESCE from both Buckets)
    'misc_bucketBA'                                           AS [report_name],
    COALESCE(src.[accounting_period], rpt.[accounting_period]) AS [accounting_period],
    COALESCE(src.[lob], rpt.[lob])                             AS [lob],
    COALESCE(src.[jurisdiction], rpt.[jurisdiction])           AS [jurisdiction],

    -- 2. Claim Counts (Source vs Report)
    COALESCE(src.[src_total_claims], 0)                        AS [src_total_claims],
    COALESCE(rpt.[rpt_total_claims], 0)                        AS [rpt_total_claims],

    -- 3. Net Liability (Total Reserve Balance)
    COALESCE(src.[src_net_liab_amt], 0.00)                     AS [src_net_liab_amt],
    COALESCE(rpt.[rpt_net_liab_amt], 0.00)                     AS [rpt_net_liab_amt],

    -- 4. Component Breakdown Amounts
    COALESCE(src.[src_approved_amt], 0.00)                     AS [src_approved_amt],
    COALESCE(rpt.[rpt_approved_amt], 0.00)                     AS [rpt_approved_amt],

    COALESCE(src.[src_access_fee], 0.00)                       AS [src_access_fee],
    COALESCE(rpt.[rpt_access_fee], 0.00)                       AS [rpt_access_fee],

    COALESCE(src.[src_claim_liab_amt], 0.00)                   AS [src_claim_liab_amt],
    COALESCE(rpt.[rpt_claim_liab_amt], 0.00)                   AS [rpt_claim_liab_amt],

    COALESCE(src.[src_admin_amt], 0.00)                        AS [src_admin_amt],
    COALESCE(rpt.[rpt_admin_amt], 0.00)                        AS [rpt_admin_amt]

FROM Aggregated_BucketBA_src src
FULL OUTER JOIN Aggregated_BucketBA_rpt rpt
    ON  src.[accounting_period] = rpt.[accounting_period]
    AND src.[lob]               = rpt.[lob]
    AND src.[jurisdiction]      = rpt.[jurisdiction];

-- 1. Original master_src_rpt rows (IH5P, IH2, IH7, IH3, IH5C, misc buckets)
CREATE      OR ALTER   view silver.open_balance_cal AS
SELECT 
    [report_name],
    [accounting_period],
    [lob],
    [jurisdiction],
    [src_total_claims],
    [rpt_total_claims],
    [src_net_liab_amt],
    [rpt_net_liab_amt],
    [src_approved_amt],
    [rpt_approved_amt],
    [src_access_fee],
    [rpt_access_fee],
    [src_claim_liab_amt],
    [rpt_claim_liab_amt],
    [src_admin_amt],
    [rpt_admin_amt]
FROM [silver].[master_src_rpt]
UNION ALL 
SELECT * FROM 
[silver].[misc_bucketAB_src_rpt]
UNION ALL 
SELECT * FROM 
[silver].[misc_bucketBA_src_rpt]
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  
    'open_balance_cal'                                 AS [report_name],
    [accounting_period],
    [lob],
    [jurisdiction],
    
    -- Total Claims (src & rpt)
    (
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH5P'                 THEN ISNULL([src_total_claims], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH2'                  THEN ISNULL([src_total_claims], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'misc_bucketBA_src_rpt' THEN ISNULL([src_total_claims], 0) ELSE 0 END)
    ) - (
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH7'                  THEN ISNULL([src_total_claims], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH3'                  THEN ISNULL([src_total_claims], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'misc_bucketAB_src_rpt' THEN ISNULL([src_total_claims], 0) ELSE 0 END)
    ) AS [src_total_claims],
    
    (
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH5P'                 THEN ISNULL([rpt_total_claims], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH2'                  THEN ISNULL([rpt_total_claims], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'misc_bucketBA_src_rpt' THEN ISNULL([rpt_total_claims], 0) ELSE 0 END)
    ) - (
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH7'                  THEN ISNULL([rpt_total_claims], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH3'                  THEN ISNULL([rpt_total_claims], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'misc_bucketAB_src_rpt' THEN ISNULL([rpt_total_claims], 0) ELSE 0 END)
    ) AS [rpt_total_claims],
    -- Net Liability Amounts (src & rpt)
    (
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH5P'                 THEN ISNULL([src_net_liab_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH2'                  THEN ISNULL([src_net_liab_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'misc_bucketBA_src_rpt' THEN ISNULL([src_net_liab_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END)
    ) - (
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH7'                  THEN ISNULL([src_net_liab_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH3'                  THEN ISNULL([src_net_liab_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'misc_bucketAB_src_rpt' THEN ISNULL([src_net_liab_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END)
    ) AS [src_net_liab_amt],
    
    (
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH5P'                 THEN ISNULL([rpt_net_liab_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH2'                  THEN ISNULL([rpt_net_liab_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'misc_bucketBA_src_rpt' THEN ISNULL([rpt_net_liab_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END)
    ) - (
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH7'                  THEN ISNULL([rpt_net_liab_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH3'                  THEN ISNULL([rpt_net_liab_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'misc_bucketAB_src_rpt' THEN ISNULL([rpt_net_liab_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END)
    ) AS [rpt_net_liab_amt],
    -- Approved Indemnity Amounts
    (
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH5P'                 THEN ISNULL([src_approved_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH2'                  THEN ISNULL([src_approved_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'misc_bucketBA_src_rpt' THEN ISNULL([src_approved_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END)
    ) - (
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH7'                  THEN ISNULL([src_approved_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH3'                  THEN ISNULL([src_approved_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'misc_bucketAB_src_rpt' THEN ISNULL([src_approved_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END)
    ) AS [src_approved_amt],
    
    (
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH5P'                 THEN ISNULL([rpt_approved_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH2'                  THEN ISNULL([rpt_approved_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'misc_bucketBA_src_rpt' THEN ISNULL([rpt_approved_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END)
    ) - (
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH7'                  THEN ISNULL([rpt_approved_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH3'                  THEN ISNULL([rpt_approved_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'misc_bucketAB_src_rpt' THEN ISNULL([rpt_approved_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END)
    ) AS [rpt_approved_amt],
    -- Access Fee / Deductibles
    (
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH5P'                 THEN ISNULL([src_access_fee], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH2'                  THEN ISNULL([src_access_fee], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'misc_bucketBA_src_rpt' THEN ISNULL([src_access_fee], 0) ELSE 0 END)
    ) - (
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH7'                  THEN ISNULL([src_access_fee], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH3'                  THEN ISNULL([src_access_fee], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'misc_bucketAB_src_rpt' THEN ISNULL([src_access_fee], 0) ELSE 0 END)
    ) AS [src_access_fee],
    
    (
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH5P'                 THEN ISNULL([rpt_access_fee], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH2'                  THEN ISNULL([rpt_access_fee], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'misc_bucketBA_src_rpt' THEN ISNULL([rpt_access_fee], 0) ELSE 0 END)
    ) - (
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH7'                  THEN ISNULL([rpt_access_fee], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH3'                  THEN ISNULL([rpt_access_fee], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'misc_bucketAB_src_rpt' THEN ISNULL([rpt_access_fee], 0) ELSE 0 END)
    ) AS [rpt_access_fee],
    -- Claim Loss Liability
    (
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH5P'                 THEN ISNULL([src_claim_liab_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH2'                  THEN ISNULL([src_claim_liab_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'misc_bucketBA_src_rpt' THEN ISNULL([src_claim_liab_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END)
    ) - (
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH7'                  THEN ISNULL([src_claim_liab_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH3'                  THEN ISNULL([src_claim_liab_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'misc_bucketAB_src_rpt' THEN ISNULL([src_claim_liab_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END)
    ) AS [src_claim_liab_amt],
    
    (
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH5P'                 THEN ISNULL([rpt_claim_liab_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH2'                  THEN ISNULL([rpt_claim_liab_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'misc_bucketBA_src_rpt' THEN ISNULL([rpt_claim_liab_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END)
    ) - (
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH7'                  THEN ISNULL([rpt_claim_liab_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH3'                  THEN ISNULL([rpt_claim_liab_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'misc_bucketAB_src_rpt' THEN ISNULL([rpt_claim_liab_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END)
    ) AS [rpt_claim_liab_amt],
    -- Administrative Expenses (ALAE)
    (
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH5P'                 THEN ISNULL([src_admin_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH2'                  THEN ISNULL([src_admin_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'misc_bucketBA_src_rpt' THEN ISNULL([src_admin_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END)
    ) - (
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH7'                  THEN ISNULL([src_admin_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH3'                  THEN ISNULL([src_admin_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'misc_bucketAB_src_rpt' THEN ISNULL([src_admin_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END)
    ) AS [src_admin_amt],
    
    (
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH5P'                 THEN ISNULL([rpt_admin_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH2'                  THEN ISNULL([rpt_admin_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'misc_bucketBA_src_rpt' THEN ISNULL([rpt_admin_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END)
    ) - (
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH7'                  THEN ISNULL([rpt_admin_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH3'                  THEN ISNULL([rpt_admin_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'misc_bucketAB_src_rpt' THEN ISNULL([rpt_admin_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END)
    ) AS [rpt_admin_amt]
FROM [silver].[master_src_rpt]
WHERE [report_name] IN ('IH5P', 'IH2', 'misc_bucketBA_src_rpt', 'IH7', 'IH3', 'misc_bucketAB_src_rpt')
GROUP BY [accounting_period], [lob], [jurisdiction]

CREATE OR ALTER VIEW silver.roll_forward_variance AS 
SELECT 
    'roll_forward_variance' AS [report_name], 
    [accounting_period], 
    [lob], 
    [jurisdiction], 
    
    -- 1. Claims Count: SUM(IH5C) - SUM(open_balance_cal) 
    ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH5C' THEN [src_total_claims] ELSE 0 END) - 
           SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'open_balance_cal' THEN [src_total_claims] ELSE 0 END), 0) AS [src_total_claims], 
           
    ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH5C' THEN [rpt_total_claims] ELSE 0 END) - 
           SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'open_balance_cal' THEN [rpt_total_claims] ELSE 0 END), 0) AS [rpt_total_claims], 
           
    -- 2. Net Liability (Total Reserve): SUM(IH5C) - SUM(open_balance_cal) 
    ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH5C' THEN [src_net_liab_amt] ELSE 0.00 END) - 
           SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'open_balance_cal' THEN [src_net_liab_amt] ELSE 0.00 END), 0.00) AS [src_net_liab_amt], 
           
    ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH5C' THEN [rpt_net_liab_amt] ELSE 0.00 END) - 
           SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'open_balance_cal' THEN [rpt_net_liab_amt] ELSE 0.00 END), 0.00) AS [rpt_net_liab_amt], 
           
    -- 3. Approved Payment Amount 
    ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH5C' THEN [src_approved_amt] ELSE 0.00 END) - 
           SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'open_balance_cal' THEN [src_approved_amt] ELSE 0.00 END), 0.00) AS [src_approved_amt], 
           
    ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH5C' THEN [rpt_approved_amt] ELSE 0.00 END) - 
           SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'open_balance_cal' THEN [rpt_approved_amt] ELSE 0.00 END), 0.00) AS [rpt_approved_amt], 
           
    -- 4. Access Fee (Deductible / Co-pay) 
    ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH5C' THEN [src_access_fee] ELSE 0.00 END) - 
           SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'open_balance_cal' THEN [src_access_fee] ELSE 0.00 END), 0.00) AS [src_access_fee], 
           
    ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH5C' THEN [rpt_access_fee] ELSE 0.00 END) - 
           SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'open_balance_cal' THEN [rpt_access_fee] ELSE 0.00 END), 0.00) AS [rpt_access_fee], 
           
    -- 5. Claim Liability Amount 
    ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH5C' THEN [src_claim_liab_amt] ELSE 0.00 END) - 
           SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'open_balance_cal' THEN [src_claim_liab_amt] ELSE 0.00 END), 0.00) AS [src_claim_liab_amt], 
           
    ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH5C' THEN [rpt_claim_liab_amt] ELSE 0.00 END) - 
           SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'open_balance_cal' THEN [rpt_claim_liab_amt] ELSE 0.00 END), 0.00) AS [rpt_claim_liab_amt], 
           
    -- 6. Admin Amount 
    ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH5C' THEN [src_admin_amt] ELSE 0.00 END) - 
           SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'open_balance_cal' THEN [src_admin_amt] ELSE 0.00 END), 0.00) AS [src_admin_amt], 
           
    ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH5C' THEN [rpt_admin_amt] ELSE 0.00 END) - 
           SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'open_balance_cal' THEN [rpt_admin_amt] ELSE 0.00 END), 0.00) AS [rpt_admin_amt] 
           
FROM [silver].[open_balance_cal] 
WHERE [report_name] IN ('IH5C', 'open_balance_cal') 
GROUP BY [accounting_period], [lob], [jurisdiction];

CREATE  OR ALTER  VIEW silver.src_rpt_var as
SELECT 
    [report_name], 
    [accounting_period], 
    [lob], 
    [jurisdiction], 
    
    -- Claims Comparison & Variance
    [src_total_claims], 
    [rpt_total_claims], 
    ISNULL([rpt_total_claims], 0) - ISNULL([src_total_claims], 0) AS [variance_total_claims], 
    
    -- Net Liability Comparison & Variance
    [src_net_liab_amt], 
    [rpt_net_liab_amt],
    ISNULL([rpt_net_liab_amt], 0) - ISNULL([src_net_liab_amt], 0) AS [variance_net_liab_amt],
    -- Approved Amount Comparison & Variance
    [src_approved_amt], 
    [rpt_approved_amt],
    ISNULL([rpt_approved_amt], 0) - ISNULL([src_approved_amt], 0) AS [variance_approved_amt],
    -- Access Fee Comparison & Variance
    [src_access_fee], 
    [rpt_access_fee],
    ISNULL([rpt_access_fee], 0) - ISNULL([src_access_fee], 0) AS [variance_access_fee],
    -- Claim Liability Comparison & Variance
    [src_claim_liab_amt], 
    [rpt_claim_liab_amt],
    ISNULL([rpt_claim_liab_amt], 0) - ISNULL([src_claim_liab_amt], 0) AS [variance_claim_liab_amt],
    -- Admin Amount Comparison & Variance
    [src_admin_amt], 
    [rpt_admin_amt],
    ISNULL([rpt_admin_amt], 0) - ISNULL([src_admin_amt], 0) AS [variance_admin_amt]
FROM (
    SELECT * FROM [silver].[open_balance_cal]
    UNION ALL 
    SELECT * FROM [silver].[roll_forwrad_variance]
) AS [combined_data];
